items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: We worked together when Paul Simon was through the show.

ctx.x: You could switch chairs with him, put him on SNL.

Yeah he’d be fine. We worked together when Paul Simon was through the show. Yeah that would be quite the challenge, that would be quite the amazing thing to do. You know and it’s funny people, and I think rightly so, look at some of those Steely Dan records as just sort of the pinnacle, like the urrtex of how you create a pop record. But there are also just other — and the same way some people I would love to hear like these original multi-tracks from the Beatles stuff and so forth — well sure, who wouldn’t? But…
Which means that when they recorded it the reverb was on. When you say baked into the track.
